about: The 337c173f follow-up (2026-11-25): is fix 337c173f966c masked at the tip by 6bda1a98b7ce, or does the migration test not reach its bug? Each case reverses the listed fixes' non-test changes at the pull's tip bae28a1b11f4, in the listed order, runs ext4_migrate_test, and watches one expectation: fs/ext4/migrate-test.c:1351, KUNIT_EXPECT_FALSE(test, migrate_was_freed(ctx, ext_idx_pblk)) in part 2 of test_ext_migrate_credit_or_dirty_failure_keeps_live_blocks, which fails ext4_mark_inode_dirty() inside ext4_ext_swap_inode_data() after the swap and checks that the migrated inode's extent index block was not freed (337c173f's bug, by its own message).

evidence.read_at: bae28a1b11f4, fs/ext4/migrate.c and fs/ext4/migrate-test.c from GitHub's raw files, 2026-11-25; the three fixes' diffs from GitHub's commit API (step 1's copies)

guards.337c173f966c1fbb1aad6dfdf4243323e3b7e304: after ext4_ext_swap_inode_data() fails, ext4_ext_migrate() calls free_ext_block(handle, tmp_inode) only when the inode has no EXTENTS flag (migrate.c:574 at the tip); in part 2 the flag is set (migrate.c:327) before the failing ext4_mark_inode_dirty() (migrate.c:358), so the call is skipped
guards.6bda1a98b7ce2f88a0e206756999f608f8437722: ext4_ext_swap_inode_data() calls ext4_ext_init_root(tmp_inode) right after copying i_data (migrate.c:334 at the tip), so tmp_inode's tree has depth 0 before anything can fail, and free_ext_block() returns at once on depth 0 (migrate.c:409)

not_guards.bfb8f5ce8815bb99770e355a916348df98181f18: moves the resets of tmp_inode's size, block count and checksum seed before ext4_journal_ensure_credits() in ext4_ext_migrate(); part 2 fails no credit call, so it does not touch whether free_ext_block() runs there (its own test is part 1, lines 1324 to 1329)
